scenarios.title: Login with valid credentials
scenarios.objective: Verify that a registered user can sign in.

scenarios.title: Login with invalid credentials
scenarios.objective: Verify that invalid credentials do not grant access.

scenarios.title: Submit login without a required field
scenarios.objective: Verify handling of missing required input.

test_cases.title: Successful login
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated and redirected to the authenticated area.

test_cases.title: Reject invalid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: Authentication is denied and the user receives an appropriate error.

test_cases.title: Submit without username
test_cases.expected_result: The required username is validated and authentication is not granted.
